title: Rin Mutiny
definition: The Royal Indian Navy (RIN) Mutiny, also known as the Bombay Mutiny, was a widespread revolt by Indian sailors of the Royal Indian Navy on ships and shore establishments in February 1946 against the British colonial administration.
importanceInUpsc: It is a critical turning point in the 'Third Phase of the National Movement' (1945-47), signaling the collapse of the British Raj's control over the armed forces, which ultimately accelerated the decision to transfer power.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Rin Mutiny.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
